o: Bring the Tablet of Ryun'eh to Theldurin the Lost.
Gather 5 Intact Raptor Horns from Sunscale Scytheclaws, and bring them to Mebok Mizzyrix in Ratchet.
Report back to Tonga Runetotem with your findings.
Return to Tonga at The Crossroads, after investigating the Stagnant Oasis.
Bring 8 Altered Snapjaw Shells to Tonga Runetotem at the Crossroads.
Bring the Gems of Cobrahn, Anacondra, Pythas and Serpentis to Nara Wildmane in Thunder Bluff.
Crane Operator Bigglefuzz in Ratchet wants you to retrieve the bottle of 99-Year-Old Port from Mad Magglish who is hiding in the Wailing Caverns.
Apothecary Zamah in Thunder Bluff wants you to collect 10 Serpentbloom.
Bring the Book of Ur to Keeper Bel'dugur at the Apothecarium in the Undercity.
Kill Arugal and bring his head to Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher.
Kill High Inquisitor Whitemane, Scarlet Commander Mograine, Herod, the Scarlet Champion and Houndmaster Loksey and then report back to Varimathras in the Undercity.
Retrieve the Compendium of the Fallen from the Monastery in Tirisfal Glades and return to Sage Truthseeker in Thunder Bluff.
Return Vorrel Sengutz's wedding ring to Monika Sengutz in Tarren Mill.
Find the Deathstalker Adamant and Deathstalker Vincent.
Bring Razorflank's Heart to Auld Stonespire in Thunder Bluff.
Bring 1 pile of Kraul Guano to Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity.
Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity wants 20 Hearts of Zeal.
Escort Willix the Importer out of Razorfen Kraul.
If you have faith, leap from the planks overlooking Thousand Needles.
Bring Grenka's Claw to Dorn Plainstalker in Thousand Needles.
Bring Fragments of Rok'Alim to Dorn Plainstalker in Thousand Needles.
Find Braug Dimspirit near the entrance to Talondeep Path in Stonetalon Mountains.
Find the Legacy of the Aspects and return it to Braug Dimspirit near the entrance to Talondeep Path in Stonetalon Mountains.
Find Parqual Fintallas in Undercity.
Find The Beginnings of the Undead Threat, and return it to Parqual Fintallas in Undercity.
Grab a Crate with Holes.
Grab a Snufflenose Command Stick.
Grab and read the Snufflenose Owner's Manual.
In Razorfen Kraul, use the Crate with Holes to summon a Snufflenose Gopher, and use the Command Stick on the gopher to make it search for Tubers.
Find the Gauntlet of Gordok Might and return it to Captain Kromcrush in Dire Maul.
According to Kromcrush, the "old timey story" says that Tortheldrin - a "creepy" elf who called himself a prince - stole it from one of the Gordok kings.
Fel'zerul in Stonard wants you to gather 10 Atal'ai Artifacts.
Bring the Bundle of Atal'ai Artifacts to the Atal'ai Exile in the Hinterlands.
Return to Fel'Zerul in Stonard.
Collect 20 Fetishes of Hakkar and bring them to Fel'Zerul in Stonard.
The Atal'ai Exile in The Hinterlands wants the Head of Jammal'an.
Nalpak in the Wailing Caverns wants 20 Deviate Hides.
Ebru in the Wailing Caverns wants you to kill 7 Deviate Ravagers, 7 Deviate Vipers, 7 Deviate Shamblers and 7 Deviate Dreadfangs.
Speak with Hamuul Runetotem.
Speak with Nara Wildmane.
Bring 6 portions of Wailing Essence to Mebok Mizzyrix in Ratchet.
Bring 12 Magenta Fungus Caps to Jarkal Mossmeld in Kargath.
Bring 5 Buzzard Gizzards, 10 Crag Coyote Fangs, and 5 Rock Elemental Shards to Jarkal Mossmeld in Kargath, Badlands.
Speak with stone watcher and learn what ancient lore it keeps. Once you have learned what lore it has to offer, activate the Discs of Norgannon.
Take the miniature version of the Discs of Norgannon to the one of the sages in Thunder Bluff.
Look for a valuable necklace within the Uldaman dig site and bring it back to Dran Droffers in Orgrimmar. The necklace may be damaged.
Find a clue as to the gems' whereabouts in the depths of Uldaman.
Find someone who can translate the paladin's journal. The closest location that might have someone is Kargath, in the Badlands.
Let Jarkal borrow the necklace. In exchange, he will translate the journal for you.

2339.n: Find the Gems and Power Source
o: Recover all three gems and a power source for the necklace from Uldaman, and then bring them to Jarkal Mossmeld in Kargath. Jarkal believes a power source might be found on the strongest construct present in Uldaman.
From the journal, you know...
* The ruby has been stashed in a barricaded Shadowforge area.
* The topaz has been hidden in an urn in one of the Trogg areas, near some Alliance dwarves.
Deliver the Necklace and Gem Salvage to Dran Droffers in Orgrimmar.
Visit Jarkal Mossmeld in Kargath to see if he was successful.
Get Patrick Garrett's family treasure from their family chest in the South Common Hall of Uldaman, and bring it to him in the Undercity.
Bring 8 Dentrium Power Stones and 8 An'Alleum Power Stones to Rigglefuzz in the Badlands.
Bring the Divino-matic Rod to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan.
Bring Gahz'rilla's Electrified Scale to Wizzle Brassbolts in the Shimmering Flats.
Retrieve the Rig Blueprints and Thermaplugg's Safe Combination from Gnomeregan and bring them to Nogg in Orgrimmar.
Speak with Scooty in Booty Bay.
Wait for Scooty to calibrate the Goblin Transponder.
Bring the Tiara of the Deep to Tabetha in Dustwallow Marsh.
Speak with Tabetha in Dustwallow Marsh.
Speak with Tran'rek in Gadgetzan.
Bring 5 Uncracked Scarab Shells to Tran'rek in Gadgetzan.
Escort Kernobee to the Clockwerk Run exit and then report to Scooty in Booty Bay.
Bring a Venom Bottle to an apothecary in Tarren Mill.
Bring an Undamaged Venom Sac to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.
Speak with Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village.
Read from the Tablet of Theka to learn the name of the Witherbark spider god, then return to Master Gadrin.
Figure out a way to remove the grime from the Grime-Encrusted Ring.
You may either keep the ring, or you may find the person responsible for the imprint and engravings on the inside of the band.
Insert a Grime-Encrusted Item into the Sparklematic 5200, and be sure to have three silver coins to start the machine.
Bring 20 Vials of Troll Temper to Trenton Lighthammer in Gadgetzan.
Andrew Brownell wants you to kill Amnennar the Coldbringer and return his skull.
Place the Essence of Eranikus in the Essence Font located in this lair in the Sunken Temple.
Find Marvon Rivetseeker in Tanaris.
Listen as Kalaran Windblade tells his story.
Collect 4 Hearts of Flame and 4 globes of Golem Oil and return the items to Kalaran Windblade.
Bring 8 Thorium Plated Daggers to Kalaran Windblade.
Retrieve the Stone Circle from Marvon Rivetseeker's workshop in Ratchet.
Find the Altar of Hakkar in the Sunken Temple in Swamp of Sorrows.
Travel into the Sunken Temple and discover the secret hidden in the circle of statues.
Find and return a Symbol of Ragnaros to Kalaran Windblade.
Wait for Kalaran Windblade to complete the Torch of Retribution.
Take the Torch of Retribution.
Speak with Squire Maltrake.
Set the North, South, East, and West Sentry Towers on fire by using the Torch of Retribution inside each of the buildings.
Open the chest.
Capture the spirits of 3 screechers in Feralas, then return to Yeh'kinya in Steamwheedle Port.
If you agree to aid Belnistrasz, speak with him again and hand the Oathstone he gave you back to him.
Escort Belnistrasz to the Quilboar's idol in Razorfen Downs.
Protect Belnistrasz while he performs the ritual to shut down the idol.
Bring the First and Second Mosh'aru Tablets to Yeh'kinya in Tanaris.
Bring the Filled Egg of Hakkar to Yeh'kinya in Tanaris.
Speak with Franclorn Forgewright if you are interested in obtaining a key to the city major.
Slay Fineous Darkvire and recover the great hammer, Ironfel. Take Ironfel to the Shrine of Thaurissan and place it on the statue of Franclorn Forgewright.
Travel to the quarry in Blackrock Mountain and slay Overmaster Pyron. Return to Thunderheart when you have completed this assignment.
Enter Blackrock Depths and track down Lord Incendius. Slay him and return any source of information you may find to Thunderheart.
Find Commander Gor'shak in Blackrock Depths.
You recall that the crudely drawn picture of the orc included bars drawn over the portrait. Perhaps you should search for a prison of some sort.
Defend Gor'shak.
Speak with Kharan Mighthammer and gather information about Princess Moira Bronzebeard's kidnapping. Take that information to Thrall in Orgrimmar.
You recall Gor'shak mentioning that Kharan is being held in a cell nearby.
Speak with Thrall if you are prepared to take on the mission he has planned.
Slay Emperor Dagran Thaurissan and free Princess Moira Bronzebeard from his evil spell.
Return to Thrall!
Show Cyrus Therepentous the Black Dragonflight Molt you received from Kalaran Windblade.
Show Cyrus Therepentous proof of your worth.
You have a feeling that Cyrus already knows that you are unworthy.
Travel to Blackrock Depths and slay Bael'Gar.
You only know that the giant resides inside Blackrock Depths. Remember to use the Altered Black Dragonflight Molt on Bael'Gar's remains to capture the Fiery Essence.
Return the Encased Fiery Essence to Cyrus Therepentous.
Venture to the Burning Steppes and recover 10 Fractured Elemental Shards for Hierophant Theodora Mulvadania.
You recall Theodora mentioning the golems and elementals of that region as being a source for these shards.
Take the Elemental Shard Sample to Lotwil Veriatus.
You recall Theodora saying that Lotwil was stationed in a camp to the east.

Find and slay Golem Lord Argelmach. Return his head to Lotwil. You will also need to collect 10 Intact Elemental Cores from the Ragereaver Golems and Warbringer Constructs protecting Argelmach. You know this because you

4081.n: KILL ON SIGHT: Dark Iron Dwarves
o: Venture to Blackrock Depths and destroy the vile aggressors!
Warlord Goretooth wants you to kill 15 Anvilrage Guardsmen, 10 Anvilrage Wardens and 5 Anvilrage Footmen. Return to him once your task is complete.

4082.n: KILL ON SIGHT: High Ranking Dark Iron Officials
o: Venture to Blackrock Depths and destroy the vile aggressors!
Warlord Goretooth wants you to kill 10 Anvilrage Medics, 10 Anvilrage Soldiers and 10 Anvilrage Officers. Return to him once your task is complete.
Escort your prisoner, Grark Lorkrub, through Burning Steppes and through Blackrock Mountain to the Searing Gorge.
You recall Lexlort mentioning that he would have his men waiting on the other side to take Grark into custody.
You will also be required to hand over your Thorium Shackles to Lexlort.
Travel to the Burning Steppes and find Grark Lorkrub. You recall Lexlort mentioning that he was last seen in a massive Blackrock fortress.

When you find Grark Lorkrub, use the Thorium Shackles to bind him and then lead him back through Blackrock Mountain to the Searing Gorge. Lexlort will have his men waiting on the other side to take Grark into custody.
Bring the Heart of the Mountain to Maxwort Uberglint in the Burning Steppes.
Travel to Blackrock Depths and slay General Angerforge! Return to Warlord Goretooth when the task is complete.
Speak with Shadowmaster Vivian Lagrave in Kargath.
Bring the Lost Thunderbrew Recipe to Vivian Lagrave in Kargath.
Bring Ribbly's Head to Yuka Screwspigot in the Burning Steppes.
Hunt 5 Bloodpetal Lashers, 5 Bloodpetal Threshers, 5 Bloodpetal Flayers and 5 Bloodpetal Trappers for Larion at Marshal's Refuge.
Deliver the Unloaded Zapper and 5 samples of Atal'ai Haze to Larion in Marshal's Refuge.
Travel to Marvon Rivetseeker's workshop in Ratchet.
Bring 4 Gromsblood, 10 Giant Silver Veins and Nagmara's Filled Vial to Mistress Nagmara in Blackrock Depths.
Speak with Yuka Screwspigot in the Burning Steppes.
Insert a Grime-Encrusted Item into the Sparklematic 5200, and be sure to have three silver coins to start the machine.
Insert a Grime-Encrusted Item into the Sparklematic 5200, and be sure to have three silver coins to start the machine.
Slay Halycon, pack mistress of the Bloodaxe worg.
Bring 8 Broodling Essence and the Draco-Incarcinatrix 900 to Tinkee Steamboil at the Flame Crest in the Burning Steppes.
Travel to Blackrock Spire and find Bloodaxe Worg Pups. Use the cage to carry the ferocious little beasts. Bring back a Caged Worg Pup to Kibler.
Use the Eggscilloscope Prototype on an egg in the Rookery.
Bring 8 Collected Dragon Eggs and the Collectronic Module to Tinkee Steamboil at Flame Crest in the Burning Steppes.
Find the three gemstones of command: The Gemstone of Smolderthorn, Gemstone of Spirestone, and Gemstone of Bloodaxe. Return them, along with the Unadorned Seal of Ascension, to Vaelan.
The Generals, as told to you by Vaelan, are: War Master Voone of the Smolderthorn; Highlord Omokk of the Spirestone; and Overlord Wyrmthalak of the Bloodaxe.
Travel to the Wyrmbog in Dustwallow Marsh. Find the ancient drake, Emberstrife and beat him without mercy until his will is broken.

It is at that moment which you must place the Unforged Seal of Ascension before the great beast. You must then be quick to use the Orb of Draconic Energy on his weakened form and claim dominion over his mental faculties.
Bring the Darkstone Tablet to Shadow Mage Vivian Lagrave in Kargath.

4769.n: Vivian Lagrave and the Darkstone Tablet
o: Speak with Shadowmage Vivian Lagrave.
Place Dawn's Gambit in the Viewing Room of the Scholomance. Defeat Vectus, then return to Betina Bigglezink.
Bring the Ancient Egg to Yeh'kinya in Tanaris.
Bring the Fifth and Sixth Mosh'aru Tablets to Prospector Ironboot in Tanaris.
Give Tinkee's Letter to Felnok Steelspring.
Bring 8 Uncracked Chillwind Horns to Felnok Steelspring.
Bring Felnok's Package to Tinkee Steamboil in the Burning Steppes.
Travel to Blackrock Spire and collect 15 Spire Spider Eggs for Kibler.
By the sound of it, these eggs could be found near spiders.

In the heart of Blackrock Spire you will find Mother Smolderweb. Engage her and get her to poison you. Chances are good that you will have to kill her as well. Return to Ragged John when you are poisoned so that he can '
Read Warosh's Scroll. Bring Warosh's Mojo to Warosh.
Slay Highlord Omokk, War Master Voone, and Overlord Wyrmthalak. Recover Important Blackrock Documents. Return to Warlord Goretooth in Kargath when the mission has been accomplished.
Speak with Tinkee Steamboil.
Speak with Eitrigg in Orgrimmar. When you have discussed matters with Eitrigg, seek council from Thrall.
You recall having seen Eitrigg in Thrall's chamber.
Travel to Blackrock Spire and slay Warchief Rend Blackhand. Take his head and return to Orgrimmar.
Travel to Blackrock Spire and find out what happened to Bijou.
Find Bijou's Belongings and return them to her. You recall her mentioning that she stashed them on the bottom floor of the city.
Take Bijou's Reconnaissance Report back to Grandmaster Lexlort in Kargath.
Talk to Malyfous Darkhammer in Everlook.
Bring the Third and Fourth Mosh'aru Tablets to Prospector Ironboot in Tanaris.
Speak with Lorax. Listen to what he has to say.
Travel to Blackrock Spire and find Goraluk Anvilcrack. Slay him and then use the Blood Stained Pike upon his corpse. After his soul has been siphoned, the pike will be Soul Stained.
You must also find the Unforged Rune Covered Breastplate.
Return both the Soul Stained Pike and the Unforged Rune Covered Breastplate to Lorax in Winterspring.
Travel to Winterspring and find Haleh. Give her Awbee's scale.
Recover 10 Plagued Flesh Samples from Stratholme and return them to Betina Bigglezink. You suspect that any creature in Stratholme would have said flesh sample.
Travel to Stratholme and search the ziggurats. Find and return new Scourge Data to Betina Bigglezink.
Find Fras Siabi's smoke shop in Stratholme and recover a box of Siabi's Premium Tobacco. Return to Smokey LaRue when the job is done.

Travel to Stratholme, in the north. Search the supply crates that litter the city and recover 5 Stratholme Holy Water. Return to Leonid Barthalomew the Revered when you have collected enough of the blessed fluid.
Travel to Stratholme and find Archivist Galford of the Scarlet Crusade. Destroy him and burn down the Scarlet Archive.
Take the Head of Balnazzar to Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff in the Eastern Plaguelands.
Venture to Stratholme and destroy Baron Rivendare. Take his head and return to Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff.
Find Egan. You only know that he was last seen around Stratholme.
Use Egan's Blaster on the ghostly and spectral citizens of Stratholme. When the restless souls break free from their ghostly shells, use the blaster again - freedom will be theirs!
Free 15 Restless Souls and return to Egan.

Venture to the Scholomance and recover the Barov family fortune. Four deeds make up this fortune: The Deed to Caer Darrow; The Deed to Brill; The Deed to Tarren Mill; and The Deed to Southshore. Return to Alexi Barov whe
Find Doctor Theolen Krastinov inside the Scholomance. Destroy him, then burn the Remains of Eva Sarkhoff and the Remains of Lucien Sarkhoff. Return to Eva Sarkhoff when the task is complete.
Return to the Scholomance with the Blood of Innocents. Find the porch and place the Blood of Innocents in the brazier. Kirtonos will come to feast upon your soul.
Fight valiantly, do not give an inch! Destroy Kirtonos and return to Eva Sarkhoff.
Travel to the Arathi Highlands, to the ruins of Stromgarde. Search Stromgarde for a Keepsake of Remembrance. If you find such an item, return with it to Magistrate Marduke.
Travel to Light's Hope in Eastern Plaguelands and seek out Leonid Barthalomew the Revered. Show him the Keepsake of Remembrance and tell him all that you have discovered.
Travel to Stratholme and find Menethil's Gift. Place the Keepsake of Remembrance upon the unholy ground.
Take the Soulbound Keepsake to Leonid Barthalomew in Eastern Plaguelands.
Return to Magistrate Marduke in Caer Darrow. Show him the Soulbound Keepsake.

Find Ras Frostwhisper in the Scholomance. When you have found him, use the Soulbound Keepsake on his undead visage. Should you succeed in reverting him to a mortal, strike him down and recover the Human Head of Ras Frost
Locate Jandice Barov in the Scholomance and destroy her. From her corpse recover Krastinov's Bag of Horrors. Return the bag to Eva Sarkhoff.
Bring 4 Bolts of Runecloth, 8 Rugged Leather, 2 Rune Threads, and Ogre Tannin to Knot Thimblejack. He is currently chained inside the Gordok wing of Dire Maul.
Bring the Frozen Eggs to Leonid Barthalomew in the Eastern Plaguelands.
Kill 20 Plagued Hatchlings, then return to Betina Bigglezink at the Light's Hope Chapel.
Bring the Frozen Eggs to Betina Bigglezink.
Slay 20 Plaguehound Runts, 5 Plaguehounds and 5 Frenzied Plaguehounds. Return to Tirion Fordring when the task is complete.
Slay 30 Plaguebats and return to Tirion Fordring.
Seek out the Carrion Grubs and Devourers of the region. Slay them and harvest their meat. Return to Tirion Fordring when you have gathered 15 Slabs of Carrion Worm Meat.
Bring the Healthy Dragon Scale to Betina Bigglezink at the Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands.
Search Ragefire Chasm for Maur Grimtotem's corpse and search it for any items of interest.
Search Orgrimmar for Ragefire Chasm, then kill 8 Ragefire Troggs and 8 Ragefire Shaman before returning to Rahauro in Thunder Bluff.
Take the Grimtotem Satchel to Rahauro in Thunder Bluff.
Bring the books Spells of Shadow and Incantations from the Nether to Varimathras in Undercity.
Bring a Lieutenant's Insignia to Thrall in Orgrimmar.
Take the Lieutenant's Insignia to Neeru Fireblade and speak to him. Gauge if he believes you are a member of the Burning Blade and then return to Thrall in Orgrimmar.
Kill Bazzalan and Jergosh the Invoker before returning to Thrall in Orgrimmar.
Listen to what Tirion Fordring has to say.
Enter Ragefire Chasm and slay Taragaman the Hungerer, then bring his heart back to Neeru Fireblade in Orgrimmar.
Travel to the Undercroft - at the southernmost section of the Eastern Plaguelands - and recover Taelan's Hammer. Return to Tirion Fordring upon completion of your objective.
Travel to Northdale, in the northeastern region of the Eastern Plaguelands, and recover the Symbol of Lost Honor. Return to Tirion Fordring upon completion of your objective.
Travel to island of Caer Darrow, in the south-central region of the Plaguelands, and look for any clues as to the whereabouts of the painting.

Travel to Stratholme, in the northern part of the Plaguelands. It is in the Scarlet Bastion that you will find the painting 'Of Love and Family,' hidden behind another painting depicting the twin moons of our world.
Return the painting to Tirion Fordring.
Travel to the northern borders of the Eastern Plaguelands and recover the Quel'Thalas Registry. The item is somewhere in the Quel'Lithien lodge.
You must also slay 8 Rangers, 8 Pathstriders, and 8 Woodsmen.

6135.n: Duskwing, Oh How I Hate Thee...
o: Find Duskwing and slay him. From the corpse, recover a Patch of Duskwing's Fur and return it to Nathanos Blightcaller.
It is said that Duskwing roams the countryside to the north of Marris Stead.
Travel to Stratholme and slay Ramstein the Gorger. Take his head as a souvenir for Nathanos.
Bring Ambassador Malcin's Head to Varimathras in the Undercity.
Take the Small Scroll to Varimathras in the Undercity.
Bring the head of Twilight Lord Kelris to Bashana Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.
Speak to Je'neu Sancrea in Ashenvale.
Bring 20 Sapphires of Aku'Mai to Je'neu Sancrea in Ashenvale.
Bring the Damp Note to Je'neu Sancrea in Ashenvale.
Kill Lorgus Jett in Blackfathom Deeps and then return to Je'neu Sancrea in Ashenvale.
Listen to Thrall.
Seek out Rexxar. The Warchief has instructed you as to his whereabouts. Search the paths of Desolace, between the Stonetalon Mountains and Feralas.
Deliver Rexxar's Letter to Myranda the Hag in the Western Plaguelands.
Travel to Blackrock Spire and collect 20 Black Dragonspawn Eyes. Return to Myranda the Hag when the task is complete.
Travel to the Wyrmbog in Dustwallow Marsh and seek out Emberstrife's Den. Once inside, wear the Amulet of Draconic Subversion and speak with Emberstrife.
You must find the blue dragonflight drake champion, Scryer, and slay him. Pry his skull from his corpse and return it to Emberstrife.
You know that Scryer can be found in Winterspring.
Destroy the drake champion of the Green Flight, Somnus. Take his skull and return it to Emberstrife.
Guarding the Caverns of Time in the Tanaris Desert is Chronalis, child of Nozdormu. Destroy him and return his skull to Emberstrife.
Travel to Grim Batol and track down Axtroz, drake champion of the Red Flight. Destroy him and take his skull. Return the skull to Emberstrife.

It would appear as if the charade is over. You know that the Amulet of Draconic Subversion that Myranda the Hag created for you will not function inside Blackrock Spire. Perhaps you should find Rexxar and explain your pr

6602.n: Blood of the Black Dragon Champion
o: Travel to Blackrock Spire and slay General Drakkisath. Gather his blood and return it to Rexxar.
Kill 8 Razorfen Battleguard, 8 Razorfen Thornweavers, and 8 Death's Head Cultists and return to Myriam Moonsinger near the entrance to Razorfen Downs.
Answer Braug Dimspirit's question successfully and then speak to him again. He will remain in Stonetalon Mountains when you are ready.
Bring the Fathom Core to Je'neu Sancrea at Zoram'gar Outpost, Ashenvale.
Travel to Ratchet to find someone that can tell you more about the glowing shard.
Then, deliver the shard as you are directed.
Collect 15 Theradric Crystal Carvings for Willow in Desolace.
Fill the Coated Cerulean Vial at the orange crystal pool in Maraudon.
Use the Filled Cerulean Vial on the Vylestem Vines to force the corrupted Noxxious Scion to emerge.
Heal 8 plants by killing these Noxxious Scion, then return to Vark Battlescar in Shadowprey Village.
Recover the two parts of the Scepter of Celebras: the Celebrian Rod and the Celebrian Diamond.
Find a way to speak with Celebras.
Assist Celebras the Redeemed while he creates the Scepter of Celebras.
Speak with him when the ritual is complete.
Slay Princess Theradras and return to Selendra near Shadowprey Village in Desolace.
Seek out Remulos in Moonglade and give him the Seed of Life.
Read the Pariah's Instructions. Afterwards, obtain the Amulet of Union from Maraudon and return it to the Centaur Pariah in southern Desolace.
Collect 10 Shadowshard Fragments from Maraudon and return them to Uthel'nay in Orgrimmar.

Travel to Blackrock Depths and recover 10 Essence of the Elements. Your first inclination is to search the golems and golem makers. You remember Vivian Lagrave also muttering something about elementals.
Travel to Dire Maul and locate the Imp, Pusillin. Convince Pusillin to give you Azj'Tordin's Book of Incantations through any means necessary.
Return to Azj'Tordin at the Lariss Pavilion in Feralas should you recover the Book of Incantations.
You must destroy the guardians surrounding the 5 Pylons that power the Prison of Immol'thar. Once the Pylons have powered down, the force field surrounding Immol'thar will have dissipated.
Enter the Prison of Immol'thar and eradicate the foul demon that stands at its heart. Finally, confront Prince Tortheldrin in Athenaeum.
Return to the Shen'dralar Ancient in the courtyard should you complete this quest.
Search Dire Maul for Kariel Winthalus. Report back to Sage Korolusk at Camp Mojache with whatever information that you may find.
Bring a Libram of Rapidity, 1 Pristine Black Diamond, 2 Large Brilliant Shards, and 2 Blood of Heroes to Lorekeeper Lydros in Dire Maul to receive an Arcanum of Rapidity.
Bring a Libram of Focus, 1 Pristine Black Diamond, 4 Large Brilliant Shards, and 2 Skin of Shadow to Lorekeeper Lydros in Dire Maul to receive an Arcanum of Focus.
Bring a Libram of Protection, 1 Pristine Black Diamond, 2 Large Brilliant Shards, and 1 Frayed Abomination Stitching to Lorekeeper Lydros in Dire Maul to receive an Arcanum of Protection.
Bring Lethtendris's Web to Talo Thornhoof at Camp Mojache in Feralas.
Speak with Talo Thornhoof at Camp Mojache in Feralas.
Return the book to its rightful owners.
Return the book to its rightful owners.
Return Foror's Compendium of Dragon Slaying to the Athenaeum.

s.n: A Dull and Flat Elven Blade

o: Give the Dull and Flat Elven Blade to Lorekeeper Lydros.
Turn the Thorium Brotherhood Contract in to Lokhtos Darkbargainer if you would like to receive the plans for Sulfuron.
Find the Gauntlet of Gordok Might and return it to Captain Kromcrush in Dire Maul.
According to Kromcrush, the "old timey story" says that Tortheldrin - a "creepy" elf who called himself a prince - stole it from one of the Gordok kings.
That is one stupid orc. It would appear as if you need to find this brand and gain the Mark of Drakkisath in order to access the Orb of Command.
The letter indicates that General Drakkisath guards the brand. Perhaps you should investigate.
Return to the Athenaeum and find the Treasure of the Shen'dralar. Claim your reward!
Travel to the continent of Teldrassil and find Malfurion's agent somewhere outside the walls of Darnassus.
Acquire 15 Silithus Venom Samples and 20 gold and bring them along with a set of Wildheart Bracers to Mokvar in Orgrimmar.
Acquire 15 Silithus Venom Samples and 20 gold and bring them along with a set of Bindings of Elements to Mokvar in Orgrimmar.
Return to Mux Manascrambler in Gadgetzan with 1 Delicate Arcanite Converter, 4 Greater Eternal Essence, 10 Stonescale Oil, 25 Volcanic Ash and 40 gold.
Take the Sealed Venom Container to Mux Manascrambler in Gadgetzan.

Use the Ectoplasmic Distiller near incorporeal undead to collect 12 Scorched Ectoplasms in Silithus, 12 Frozen Ectoplasms in Winterspring and 12 Stable Ectoplasms in the Eastern Plaguelands. Bring them along with the Ect
Find Magma Lord Bokk in the Burning Steppes, obtain his Magma Core and bring it to Mux Manascrambler in Gadgetzan.
Bring a Wildheart Belt and a set of Wildheart Gloves to Mokvar in Orgrimmar.
Search for an imp inside a cave at the entrance of Darkwhisper Gorge in southern Winterspring, purchase a Fel Elemental Rod and return to Mux Manascrambler in Gadgetzan.
Use the Extra-Dimensional Ghost Revealer at the entrance to Stratholme and speak with the ghost of Anthion Harmon.
Bring a Cord of Elements and a set of Gauntlets of Elements to Mokvar in Orgrimmar.
Go into Stratholme and rescue Ysida Harmon from Baron Rivendare.
Bring Ysida's Locket to Anthion Harmon in Eastern Plaguelands.
Bring 3 Dark Iron Bars, 20 Enchanted Leather, 3 Mooncloth and 4 Cured Rugged Hides to Anthion Harmon in the Eastern Plaguelands.
Take the incomplete Banner of Provocation to Falrin Treeshaper at the library in Dire Maul.
Collect 25 Ogre Warbeads from Ogres inside Dire Maul or Blackrock Spire and return to Falrin Treeshaper inside the Athenaeum in Dire Maul.
Bring the following to Falrin Treeshaper inside Dire Maul: 1 Jeering Spectre's Essence, 4 Dark Runes and 8 Large Brilliant Shards.
Return to Mokvar in Orgimmar with a set of Boots of Elements, Kilt of Elements and Pauldrons of Elements.
Gather the Incendicite of Incendius, the Ember of Emberseer and the Cinder of Cynders, along with a Hallowed Brazier, and return them to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.
Acquire Druidical Remains and return them to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.
Acquire a Starbreeze Village Relic and return it to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.
Retrieve a Brilliant Sword of Zealotry and return it to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.
Obtain Soul Ashes of the Banished and return them to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.

8966.n: The Left Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet
o: Use the Brazier of Beckoning to summon forth the spirit of Mor Grayhoof and slay him. Return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain with the Left Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet and the Brazier of Beckoning.

8967.n: The Left Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet
o: Use the Brazier of Beckoning to summon forth the spirit of Isalien and slay her. Return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain with the Left Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet and the Brazier of Beckoning.

8968.n: The Left Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet
o: Use the Brazier of Beckoning to summon forth Jarien and Sothos and slay them. Return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain with the Left Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet and the Brazier of Beckoning.

8969.n: The Left Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet
o: Use the Brazier of Beckoning to summon forth the spirit of Kormok and slay him. Return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain with the Left Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet and the Brazier of Beckoning.

8970.n: I See Alcaz Island In Your Future...
o: Gather 20 Bloodkelp from the Strashaz naga and then return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.
Return to Mokvar in Orgrimmar with the Extra-Dimensional Ghost Revealer.
Acquire a Starbreeze Village Relic and return it to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.
Acquire Druidical Remains and return them to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.
Retrieve a Brilliant Sword of Zealotry and return it to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.
Obtain Soul Ashes of the Banished and return them to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.

8989.n: The Right Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet
o: Use the Brazier of Beckoning to summon forth the spirit of Mor Grayhoof and slay him. Return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain with the recombined Lord Valthalak's Amulet and the Brazier of Beckoning.

8990.n: The Right Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet
o: Use the Brazier of Beckoning to summon forth the spirit of Isalien and slay her. Return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain with the recombined Lord Valthalak's Amulet and the Brazier of Beckoning.

8991.n: The Right Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet
o: Use the Brazier of Beckoning to summon forth Jarien and Sothos and slay them. Return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain with the recombined Lord Valthalak's Amulet and the Brazier of Beckoning.

8992.n: The Right Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet
o: Use the Brazier of Beckoning to summon forth the spirit of Kormok and slay him. Return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain with the recombined Lord Valthalak's Amulet and the Brazier of Beckoning.
Gather 40 Blackrock Bracers and acquire a Flask of Supreme Power. Return them to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.
Use the Brazier of Beckoning to summon Lord Valthalak. Dispatch him, and use Lord Valthalak's Amulet on the corpse. Then, return Lord Valthalak's Amulet to the Spirit of Lord Valthalak.

Travel to the Ring of the Law in Blackrock Depths and place the Banner of Provocation in its center as you are sentenced by High Justice Grimstone. Slay Theldren and his gladiators and return to Anthion Harmon in the Eas
Return to Mokvar in Orgimmar with a set of Wildheart Boots, a Wildheart Kilt and Wildheart Spaulders.
Travel to Blackrock Mountain and use the Extra-Dimensional Ghost Revealer to find Bodley near Blackrock Spire.
Bring the Blackfathom Pearl to Bashana Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.
Bring Thermaplugg's Engineering Notes to Nogg at the Valley of Honor in Orgrimmar.
Investigate the disappearance of Edward Heartweaver in the Ruins of Lordaeron.
Collect 25 Intact Limbs within The Ruins of Lordaeron for Morbin Lightbane in the Undercity.
Kill Rath'mael in the Ruins of Lordaeron for Deathguard Kristof in Brill.
Bring the Crest of Lordaeron to Oran Snakewrithe in Undercity.
Collect the Highly Toxic Strain from Witherfang in Ruins of Lordaeron for Theodore Griffs in Undercity.
Travel to the Wetlands and meet the Deathstalker Agent in the hills above the Dragonmaw camp.
Take the Titan Relic to the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff and look for someone who can tell you more about it.
Slay the Dragonmaw forces within the Excavation Site and return to the Deathstalker Agent outside with anything you recover.
Enter the Excavation Sites in the Wetlands and bring back Thicket Raptor Meat.
Slay Witch Doctor Zum'rah and bring Zum'rah's Head to Mazu'kon in Mulgore.
Recover the crystal known as An'she's Radiance from Maraudon.
Collect the Arcane Mote in the City of Dalaran for Magus Wordeen Voidglare in Tarren Mill.
Defeat Atrexis the Grave Knight in the City of Dalaran for Melisara in Tarren Mill.
Collect the Founding of Dalaran from the City of Dalaran for Rexxie Copperclutch near the sewer entrance.
Collect 6 Cracked Sentry Cores in the City of Dalaran for Doctor Martin Felben in Undercity.
Recover The Coldbringer's Eye from Razorfen Downs.
Recover a Fragment of the Firelands from Blackrock Depths for Alaana Stormwalker in Mulgore.
Deliver the Abominable Head to Master Apothecary Faranell within the Undercity.
Bring the Head of the Baron to the body of Othmar in the Undercity.

Collect a Toxic Skullcap from Tawny Grisette in the Trade Quarter, Blisterweed near the Herbalism Trainer, and Essence of Agony from the poison vendor in the Rogues' Quarter for Master Apothecary Faranell in Undercity.
Inject the Hissing Serum into the system above Othmar's body for Master Apothecary Faranell.
Speak to Warlord Goretooth to serve the Kargath Expeditionary Force.
Bring the Titan Relic to Muln Earthfury at the Skywatcher Plateau in northwest Mulgore.
